-- CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE AS SELECT

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE revenue_ctas
WITH
(
    LOCATION='ctas_enriched',
    DATA_SOURCE = MyDataLake,
    FILE_FORMAT=parquet_ff
)
AS SELECT *
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'revenue',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'MyDataLake',
    FORMAT = 'CSV',
    PARSER_VERSION='2.0',
    HEADER_ROW=TRUE
) as query;


CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT parquet_ff
WITH (
    FORMAT_TYPE = PARQUET,
    DATA_COMPRESSION = 'org.apache.hadoop.io.compress.SnappyCodec'
);


ALTER DATABASE [sambhav-serverless]
COLLATE Latin1_General_100_CI_AI_SC_UTF8;


select * from revenue_ctas;

-- How CETAS Works
-- You run a SELECT query against your source data (could be external files, views, or other tables).

-- Synapse executes the query and writes the result set into files in the specified Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS Gen2) location.

-- At the same time, Synapse creates an external table definition that points to those files.

-- You can then query the external table directly, without re‑running the original SELECT.
